notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness equal to one, except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
description:
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to a creature with toughness equal to one, except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
The creature dies as a state based action due to having zero or less toughness, triggering One with the Kami and Skullclamp.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the creature's power.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat.
